```ts
dropPrimaryKey(table: Table|string, constraintName?: string, ifExists?: boolean): Promise<void>
```

- `table` - Table object or name
- `constraintName` - constraint name (optional)
- `ifExists` - when set to `true`, silently ignores if the primary key does not exist; otherwise throws an error (default)

Drops a primary key.

---

```ts
createUniqueConstraint(table: Table|string, uniqueConstraint: TableUnique): Promise<void>
```

- `table` - Table object or name
- `uniqueConstraint` - TableUnique object to be created

Creates new unique constraint.

> Note: does not work for MySQL, because MySQL stores unique constraints as unique indexes. Use `createIndex()` method instead.

---

```ts
createUniqueConstraints(table: Table|string, uniqueConstraints: TableUnique[]): Promise<void>
```

- `table` - Table object or name
- `uniqueConstraints` - array of TableUnique objects to be created

Creates new unique constraints.

> Note: does not work for MySQL, because MySQL stores unique constraints as unique indexes. Use `createIndices()` method instead.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
